name: Fantasy
tone: Heroic high fantasy: brave deeds, ancient magic, wonder with real danger.

roles.name: Fighter
roles.summary: A trained warrior who holds the line with steel and grit.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + your level in HP.

abilities.name: Fighting Style: Defence
abilities.description: While wearing armour you gain +1 AC (the GM applies this).

roles.name: Rogue
roles.summary: A quick, quiet specialist in locks, traps and knives in the dark.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.description: Once per turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage with a finesse or ranged weapon if you have advantage or an ally is next to the target.

abilities.name: Thieves' Cant
abilities.description: You know the secret signs and slang of thieves.

roles.name: Wizard
roles.summary: A scholar of the arcane who bends reality with study and will.

abilities.name: Spellcasting (Intelligence)
abilities.description: Cantrips: Fire Bolt (1d10 fire, ranged spell attack), Mage Hand, Light. 1st-level spells prepared: Magic Missile (three darts, 1d4+1 force each, never miss), Shield (reaction, +5 AC until your next turn), Sleep, Detect Magic. Spell attack = Int mod + proficiency; save DC = 8 + Int mod + proficiency.

abilities.name: Arcane Recovery
abilities.description: Once per day during a short rest, recover one spent 1st-level spell slot.

roles.name: Cleric
roles.summary: A servant of a higher power who heals, wards and smites.

abilities.name: Spellcasting (Wisdom)
abilities.description: Cantrips: Sacred Flame (1d8 radiant, Dex save), Guidance, Light. 1st-level spells prepared: Cure Wounds (1d8 + Wis mod healing), Healing Word (bonus action, 1d4 + Wis mod at range), Bless, Guiding Bolt (4d6 radiant). Save DC = 8 + Wis mod + proficiency.

abilities.name: Disciple of Life
abilities.description: Healing spells restore an extra 2 + the spell's level in HP.

roles.name: Ranger
roles.summary: A wilderness tracker and archer at home far from roads.

abilities.name: Favoured Enemy
abilities.description: Choose a creature type with the GM: advantage on Survival to track them and on Intelligence checks to recall facts about them.

abilities.name: Natural Explorer
abilities.description: In your favoured terrain, difficult terrain doesn't slow your group and you can't get lost except by magic.

roles.name: Bard
roles.summary: A performer whose stories and songs carry real power.

abilities.name: Bardic Inspiration
abilities.description: Bonus action: give an ally a d6 they can add to one roll in the next 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Spellcasting (Charisma)
abilities.description: Cantrips: Vicious Mockery (1d4 psychic, Wis save, disadvantage on next attack), Minor Illusion. 1st-level spells known: Healing Word, Charm Person, Dissonant Whispers, Faerie Fire. Save DC = 8 + Cha mod + proficiency.

openingHooks: A dying courier stumbles into the tavern and presses a sealed map into your hands before the hooded riders arrive.
The village well has started whispering at night, and the children who listen stop speaking by morning.
The duke offers a fortune to anyone who will escort his estranged daughter through the haunted Greywood before the solstice.
artStyle: Painterly digital illustration in the style of a modern fantasy roleplaying sourcebook. Realistic proportions, detailed costume and gear, dramatic rim lighting, visible brushwork, rich but slightly muted colours.
